name: marketing-13
title: Photo studio landing page
description: An Aperline home page: a brief that types itself above four takes that sharpen out of their blur as they finish, notes pinned on a take, takes sorting themselves into Keep, Maybe and Drop, a lighting row that relights a sample beside a seed lock and the call that reproduces it, sample reviews, one offer and questions.

      <circle
        cx='12'
        cy='12'
        r='5.5'
        fill='none'
        strokeWidth='1.8'
        className='stroke-primary-foreground'
      />
      <path
        d='M12 6.5 15.5 12.8M17 14.5l-5.2 0M8.5 12.8 12 6.5'
        fill='none'
        strokeWidth='1.4'
        strokeLinecap='round'
        strokeLinejoin='round'
        className='stroke-primary-foreground/70'
      />
    </svg>
  );
}
